overview: The Council approved a Tax Increment Financing agreement for a local business and authorized a transfer to cover a projected sewer revenue deficit. Significant discussions were held regarding a proposed consumer protection ordinance and the funding of an environmental remediation project in West Medford.

items.title: Community Announcement: Winter Festival
items.summary: Residents announced a community winter festival and Polar Express movie screening to be held at Medford High School on December 17th.

items.title: Public Hearing: Conduit Petition on Boston Avenue
items.summary: The Council held in abeyance a petition from National Grid and Verizon for conduit work on Boston Avenue pending an engineering report on the quality of street repairs performed by utility companies.

items.title: Proposed Consumer Protection Ordinance
items.summary: The Council referred a proposed ordinance to the city solicitor that would require retail stores with rewards programs to automatically refund or credit customers when a pricing error is discovered.

items.title: Relocation of Vocational Holiday Lights
items.summary: The Council placed on file a report from the Mayor's office confirming that student-manufactured holiday lights will be displayed at Hormel Stadium this year due to construction at City Hall.

items.title: Sign Repositioning at Tainter and Fulton Streets
items.summary: Approved a resolution to lower or reposition a 'no left turn' sign at the corner of Tainter and Fulton Streets to improve visibility.

items.title: Transfer for OPEB Actuarial Report
items.summary: Approved a $10,000 transfer from the finance salary account to fund a mandated biennial actuarial evaluation report for post-retirement benefits.

items.title: Tax Increment Financing Agreement: Bianco Inc.
items.summary: Approved a 10-year Tax Increment Financing agreement for Bianco Inc. to facilitate the company's relocation to Brainerd Avenue and the creation of local jobs.

items.title: West Medford Environmental Remediation Funding
items.summary: The Council tabled a request for $900,000 for chemical remediation of a parking lot in West Medford to allow for further review of the legal use of water enterprise funds and the project's impact on local businesses.

items.title: Sewer Revenue Deficit Transfer
items.summary: Approved a transfer of $563,593 from sewer retained earnings to cover a projected deficit caused by stagnant rates and increased MWRA assessments.

items.title: Ceremonial Resolutions
items.summary: Approved resolutions congratulating the McGillicuddys on their 50th wedding anniversary, Officer Frank Femino on receiving a Medal of Honor, and veteran Mike Petroni on his 96th birthday.

items.title: Commercial Parking Ban Request
items.summary: Referred a request for a late-night commercial parking ban on portions of West Street and Winthrop Street to the Traffic Commission.

items.title: Appointment to Hormel Commission
items.summary: The Council tabled the appointment of Leonard A. Gliona to the Hormel Commission to allow for a formal vacancy advertisement and public vetting process.

items.title: Memorial Resolution: Bernardino Stabile
items.summary: Approved a memorial resolution for decorated World War II, Korean, and Vietnam War veteran and Secret Service agent Bernie Stabile.

items.title: Fire Recognition and Local Announcements
items.summary: Recognized firefighters for assisting in a 10-alarm Cambridge fire, encouraged holiday donations, and approved the minutes of previous meetings.
